meta.description: Hand-authored seed manifest for the Agora seed engine. Run ONCE on a clean DB via `pnpm seed`. Handles are manifest-local reference keys; the field name implies the namespace (author -> users, entity -> posts). Reactions discriminate target via on:{post|comment}. A user may override meta.defaultPassword with `password`, and carry a `roles` array (owner|admin|steward) granted as a project_roles row after sign-in.

spaces.name: The Outdoors
spaces.description: Trails, tides, and night skies — members post.

posts.author: evy
posts.title: Golden hour at the pier
posts.content: Got down to the water just as the light went amber. Twelve frames, one keeper — but what a keeper.

posts.author: alice
posts.title: Why I still shoot film
posts.content: Slower, more deliberate, and the grain does something digital still can't fake for me. Thirty-six frames keeps me honest.

posts.author: bob
posts.title: Cold brew that doesn't taste like battery acid
posts.content: Coarse grind, 1:8 coffee to water, 16 hours in the fridge, then dilute to taste. Smooth, low-acid, no bitterness.

posts.author: cara
posts.title: Day 7: my starter is finally alive
posts.content: Doubling in four hours and smelling like tangy yogurt. Named her Agnes. First loaf this weekend.

posts.author: kofi
posts.title: Low-and-slow BBQ ribs
posts.content: Six hours at 225, a light glaze in the last thirty minutes. The bark held and they pulled clean off the bone.

posts.author: lena
posts.title: Weeknight miso soup
posts.content: Dashi, a spoon of white miso off the heat so it stays alive, tofu, wakame, scallions. Ten minutes, big comfort.

posts.author: dan
posts.title: First trail 10k in the books
posts.content: Roots, switchbacks, and one creek crossing I did not stick. Slower than road pace and twice as fun.

posts.author: june
posts.title: Low tide treasures at the cove
posts.content: Anemones, a shy octopus, and more nudibranchs than I could photograph before the water came back.

posts.author: hana
posts.title: Backyard stargazing on a clear night
posts.content: Saturn's rings held steady at 150x and the Andromeda smudge was naked-eye. Worth the cold fingers.

posts.author: ivan
posts.title: Built my first mechanical keyboard
posts.content: Hand-wired, lubed switches, a little wobble on the stabilizers I'll fix later. Typing on it right now and grinning.

posts.author: gia
posts.title: New monstera leaf just unfurled
posts.content: Biggest fenestrations yet. Three years from a grocery-store cutting to this monster in the corner.

posts.author: finn
posts.title: Dialing in my turntable setup
posts.content: New cartridge, careful tracking-force, and a fresh ground wire killed the hum. Kind of Blue has never sounded better.
